Description.SourceString:
Even worshippers of the so called “god of evil”, a moniker levied on Zamorak by the Saradomin worshippers, have a need for green spaces. Nature is soothing, grounding and calming, it can do wonders for our mental health, and sometimes even those who follow the lord of chaos need somewhere to relax.

This was the courtyard once, long ago now: a place of gentle contemplation and relaxation, before the corruption took hold.

Now, it is a wild and overgrown place, infected by chickens and chincompas alike. A good place to set up camp, for those with decent survival instincts, but not somewhere you’re likely to find much of a chance to relax.
